generalCriterionList.description: Single entity or Joint venture(maximum 2 members) is Acceptable

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder should quote exclusive of GST
Tenderer are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever
Should comply all the conditions of the tender document

technicalCriterionList.description: Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than two times the annual payments from this contract (Rs. xxxxx Lakhs)
Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)
Executed in any one year the following minimum quantities of work (Cement Concrete - xxxx cum, Earthwork - xxxx cum, etc) (80% of peak rate of construction)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Owning the following key and critical equipment for this work (xxxx, xxxx, xxxx)
Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of no less than Rs. xxxxxx Lakhs (estimated cash flow for 3 months of peak construction period)
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details for reference
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
List of Financial Resources with Certificates

3.2(b) Satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value), as prime contractor, at least one similar work such as UGD project / STP project/ water supply project/ Irrigation Projects /combined water supply & sewerage project/ combined water supply & sewerage project with Road/ combined water supply & sewerage project with Layout works/ combined water supply & sewerage project with Buildings value not less than Rs. 0.94 Crores. If the bid is submitted as a joint venture, then any one partner should meet the requirement.

3.2(c) Executed in any one year of the last five years (2021-22 to 2025-26) the following minimum quantities of works. (1) Earthwork excavation in all kinds of soil by mechanical / manual means - 585 Cum (2) Cement concrete (Including RCC & PCC) - 166 Cum (3) TMT Steel - 8.14 Ton. If the bid is submitted as a joint venture, then any one partner/jointly should meet the requirement in the same financial year. Note: The certificate should be issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or Equivalent or Employer in case of Govt / Semi Govt. Authorities and General Manager in case of Public Sector Undertaking

3.2(d) The tenderer or his identified subcontractor should possess experience in Construction of 1 Nos of SBR/ NEBR/ equivalent/any other type STP/ WTP/ETP works with a minimum of 0.04 MLD Capacity. If the bid is submitted as a joint venture, then any one partner should meet the requirement. Note: (1) The Experience certificate from the competent Govt /Semi Govt. /Public sector undertaking shall be furnished. The certificate should be issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or Equivalent or Employer in case of Govt / Semi Govt. Authorities and General Manager in case of Public Sector Undertaking. (2) Turnover and the value of completed work shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the FY in which the tenders are invited. (3) Value of the work mentioned in the work done certificate shall be Excluding GST (4) If the bidder has submitted work done certificate in JV, only JV share will be considered for evaluation purpose. (5) The sub-contractor should provide his consent for associating with the bidder for this tender package. (6) The subcontractor should also provide his experience certificate/ documents for the claimed works

3.2(a) Achieved in each of the at least two financial years a minimum annual financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of Rs. 3.77 Crores (i)Audited profit and loss account statement/ balance sheets certified by the chartered accountant, (ii) Turnover certificate with UDIN and (iii) IT returns filed for the above indicated 5 years is to be uploaded along with the technical bid. If the bid is submitted as JV, then the requirement of minimum financial turnover shall be considered on the basis of combined resources. The lead partner should have an annual financial turnover of not less than 51% of total turnover indicated above in any two financial years during last 5 financial years. All document/certificates issued by a Charted Accountant should have a UDIN (unique document Identification Number) generated through the ICAI (The Institute of chartered Accountants of India) Portal. Certificate without UDIN the documents uploaded will be considered and treated as invalid documents. Note: In case of JV, Joint venture partnership deed shall be submitted as per section 10 format for Joint Venture along with the other documents through KPP Portal. (1) Individual - Rs. 3.77 Cr. (2) Joint Venture- Lead Member - Not less than Rs.1.92 Cr.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: 3(b) Liquid assets and/or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs 0.56 Crores (credit lines/letter of credit/Certificates from banks) for meeting the fund requirement etc., (equivalent of the estimated cash flow for 3 months in the peak construction period) in the form of unconditional credit lines/ letter of credit/ certificate from any Nationalized Banks/ Scheduled Banks from Karnataka - India as per the prescribed format. If the bid is submitted as a joint venture, then any one partner should meet the requirement. Note: Liquid assets in the form of credit line/ letter of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc., shall be in the format appended with the bid document. Any conditional Banker Certificate will not be accepted and will lead to disqualification

3.6 Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria will only be qualified if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under: Assessed available tender capacity means (AxNx1.50 - B) Where A means Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N means Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited B means Value, at 2026-27 price level of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 1 year. Note: (1) The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated completion period, remaining period for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent. (2) In case of JV, values of A and B shall be the sum total of the respective figures of all the Partners

itemList.description: PART- A: 2) Construction of 150KLD STP  with AABR  (Advanced Attached Growth Bio reactor) or equivalent Technology at Hoskote Town.a) Construction of AABR type STP complete including all civil works of Bar Screen Chamber, Oil Separation Tank, Equalization Tank, and 4 Nos of Sludge Drying Bed. b) Supply, Installation and Commissioning of Stainless Steel Advanced Attached Bio- Reactor Process Vessels, Post Filtration Units, necessary fixing of platforms along with railings, pumping machineries and all electromechanical components to meet required standards. c) Supply and Installation of  3 Nos of Non clog Submersible Pump suitable for sewage/ Liquid waste application for Sludge Removal from Existing Sump. d) Construction of Guard Room, Precast Compound Wall, Laying of Internal Roads, Outfall Pipeline, Boreland and Valve Chambers. e) Supply, Installation, Testing, Commissioning of Solar Net Metering and Yard Lighting for STP. f) Providing and installation of 11 KV express feeder line including transformers to the proposed STP including internal electrical works and allied accessories.Note: 1) Work shall be carried out as per the instructions of the engineer in charge. 2) All works and items shall be executed to be carried out as per IS code, CPHEEO manual, KSPCB, Prevailing NGT and Swachh Bharat Mission - Urban 2.0 guidelines and specifications mentioned in the contract. 3) Drawings are enclosed only for tender purpose 4) The effluent should meet required NGT standards.

Part B - O & M for 1st Year Hoskote Town - Operation and Maintenance of the proposed STP which includes, providing technical staff, operators, and others who are required to run the system as per Govt orders in a complete manner and providing all materials & chemicals required, for the operation of STP works.Note: Helpers / Watchman / Technical staff made available round the clock for maintenance period at STP. The contractor should maintain a Logbook on the working of pumping machinery at the STP. The effluent should meet required NGT standards and contractor should submit report.

Part B - O & M for 2nd Year Hoskote Town - Operation and Maintenance of the proposed STP which includes, providing technical staff, operators, and others who are required to run the system as per Govt orders in a complete manner and providing all materials & chemicals required, for the operation of STP works 1. Regular maintenance of all civil structures inside the STP premises. The maintenance consists of all kinds of repairs to damaged structures, cleaning and washing, and painting for civil structures   2. Operation and maintenance of all kinds of pumping machinery, and other mechanical components including electrical maintenance covering all repairs/replacement of transformers / electrical cable/switchboards/replacement of burnt parts of machinery all the above repairs & maintenance will be carried out as per the direction of the Engineer-in-charge for the satisfactory functioning of the STP.
